| **Jul 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | **No** (observed Mon 3) |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | **Yes** (Mon‑Tue) |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | **Yes** (Mon‑Tue) |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Monday | **Yes** (Mon‑Tue) |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | **Yes** (Mon‑Tue) |
